notes: IMDwindowshopper (WWW) is a plain OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals and a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (10^27 minor units), minted once in its parameterless constructor to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no owner, no further minting, no fees, burns, pauses or blacklists, so the factory's transfers to the distributor, the pool seed and pool swaps all move exactly what they state. The launch deploys no application contracts.
